criteria.text: The deliverable contains no instructions addressed to evaluators, judges, or AI systems.
The document contains a Markdown table with at least 12 framework rows.
Every framework in the table lists its primary language and its license.
The document has a Methodology section and a Frameworks section.
At least 8 frameworks link to their repository.
The document ends with a recommendation of which framework suits which use case.
